candidateRules.indicator: Bollinger Bands on the most recent 20 ticks including decision tick; center is arithmetic mean; standard deviation is population SD; upper/lower = center +/- 2 SD.
candidateRules.direction: Rise if decision quote is strictly below lower band; Fall if strictly above upper band; otherwise NO TRADE.

candidateRules.indicator: RSI(14) using Wilder smoothing of upward/downward quote differences, seeded by the first 14 differences; current decision tick included.
candidateRules.direction: Rise if RSI is strictly below 30; Fall if RSI is strictly above 70; otherwise NO TRADE.

fixedReplayRules.entryAndExpiry: Signal at t; hypothetical entry at t+delay ticks; expiry at entry+5 ticks. Never bridge a missing second. At most one open hypothetical contract per candidate/delay; next decision strictly after settlement.
fixedReplayRules.assumptions: Public tick replay is not an executable quote. Payouts and entry delays are scenarios, not actual fills.

evaluation.timing: No eligible-window strategy performance inspection before 2026-10-08T00:00:00Z and collector completion.
evaluation.archiveGate: Verify the exact UTC-second window with chunk SHA-256, row counts, bounds, duplicates/conflicts, and explicit missing ranges. At least 99.9% genuine-second coverage is required for descriptive replay; no interpolation.
evaluation.outcome: Only DEVELOPMENT_ONLY or INCONCLUSIVE. Log every fixed candidate/delay/payout scenario with observations, wins/losses/ties, signed average per $1, and no-signal counts. This seven-hour pilot cannot pass the original 14-day gate, prove profit, authorize Demo or real orders, or permit Bot Builder Run.
evaluation.platformParity: Deriv Bot BB rounding, RSI flat-series behavior and tick/tick-list timing differ or remain unverified. Do not claim Bot Builder equivalence.
